title: 划分与取舍：Partitioning 导论
Partition with Purpose: An Introduction
why: 从两组分工开始，理解为什么不能只追求更小的割代价。用同一张五节点图解释 cut、人数与面积，再认识初始构造、KL/FM、谱二分和多路划分。看完后，你会知道从哪一章开始，以及在实验中应该检查什么。

Start with a two-team assignment and see why a small cut alone is not enough. A shared five-vertex graph introduces cut cost, counts and areas, followed by construction, KL/FM, spectral and k-way methods. Learn where to begin and what to inspect in the labs.

music.title: Boundaries / 边界
music.source: Original procedural score; no third-party recording

title: 把任务分给两个小组
Assign the work to two teams
beats: 一个项目，需要两个小组协作。
A project needs two collaborating teams.
联系紧密的任务，最好留在一起。
Keep closely linked tasks together.

title: 少沟通，也要放得下
Fewer crossings, but the parts must fit
beats: 全放一组，跨组沟通可以为零。
One part can have zero crossings.
但空间与工作量，不允许这样分。
Space and workload can forbid that assignment.

title: 划分与取舍
Partition with Purpose
beats: Partitioning：在约束下划分。
Partitioning means dividing under constraints.

title: 芯片也需要划分区域
A chip also needs regions
beats: 芯片单元彼此连线，也需要分区。
Connected circuit cells also need regions.
跨区域连接，是这里衡量的代价。
Cross-region connections contribute to our cost.

title: 先用五个节点说清楚
Make the cost explicit on five vertices
beats: 先用五个节点，把代价算清楚。
Use five vertices to make the cost explicit.
边权表示切开这条连接的代价。
An edge weight is the cost of cutting that connection.

title: 跨边的权重，逐条相加
Add the crossing weights, once per edge
beats: 跨组边的权重，逐条相加。
Add the crossing edge weights, one by one.
总和为12，每条无向边只算一次。
The sum is 12. Count each undirected edge once.

title: 换一种分法，cut 从 12 到 3
A different assignment: cut 12 to 3
beats: 换成 ABC | DE，代价会怎样？
Try ABC | DE. What happens to the cut?
cut 为 3，人数仍是二与三。
The cut is 3; the counts are still two and three.

title: 人数与面积，是不同的约束
Counts and areas are different constraints
beats: 人数平衡，不等于面积可行。
Balanced counts do not guarantee feasible areas.
A 面积变为 4，ABC 面积变为 6。
Set A's area to 4: ABC then has area 6.

title: 五个节点，也有多种分法
Even five vertices allow many splits
beats: 五个节点，有十五种非空二分。
Five vertices have 15 nonempty, unlabeled splits.
若限定二与三，则剩十种。
Requiring counts two and three leaves ten.

title: 规模一大，就不能逐一试遍
Exhaustive search soon becomes impractical
beats: 一百个节点，候选已是三十位数。
At 100 vertices, the count already has 30 digits.
逐一试遍，很快就不再现实。
Trying every split soon becomes impractical.

title: Lesson 03 · 先构造一个起点
Lesson 03 · Construct a starting point
beats: 先构造起点：随机、贪心、生长。
Construct a start: random, greedy, or growing.
生长吸收 B，得到 cut 5。
Growing adds B, producing cut 5.

title: Lesson 04–05 · KL 与 FM 改进
Lessons 04–05 · KL and FM refinement
beats: KL 成对交换，FM 单点移动。
KL exchanges a pair; FM moves one vertex.
先试探、锁定，再选最佳前缀。
Try, lock, then keep the best prefix.

title: Lesson 06 · 谱方法产生排序
Lesson 06 · Spectral structure gives an order
beats: 谱方法用矩阵结构，给节点排序。
Spectral structure orders the vertices.
扫描合法切口，选择较小的 cut。
Sweep legal thresholds for a smaller cut.

title: Lesson 07 · 在子图上继续二分
Lesson 07 · Split the induced subgraphs
beats: 继续二分，就能得到更多分组。
Repeated bisection produces more parts.
每次在当前子图上重新计算。
Each split solves its current induced subgraph.

title: Lesson 08 · 同图比较多路方法
Lesson 08 · Compare k-way methods fairly
beats: 同一张图，比较不同多路方法。
Compare k-way methods on the same graph.
先检查容量，再比较 cut。
Check capacity before comparing cut.

title: 从 Lesson 02 开始
Begin with Lesson 02
beats: 从割代价开始，用实验和代码检验判断。
Start with cut cost. Test your reasoning with labs and code.
